title: SPI and I2C in hardware
summary: Fast, exact SPI (up to 50 MHz, all 4 modes, 1 to 32 bits) on J2 and an I2C controller (100 kHz to 1 MHz, clock stretching) on the board's I2C bus: displays, sensors, ADCs, memories.
wiring: SPI device CS / MOSI (DIN) / MISO (DOUT) / SCLK
pin 3 / pin 4 of any of J1..J8
the board has 1 kohm pull-ups to 3.3 V
parts: any SPI module (MAX7219 display, MCP3008 ADC, W25Q flash...)
any I2C module (BME280, SSD1306 OLED, DS3231 clock...)
tested: the self-test passed 18 of 18 checks on the real board (October 2026), with nothing connected.
